text: あれは　ぜんぶで　１０しゅるい　いじょう　あるんだぜ　どこにいく　ふねかは　しらんが

structure.jp: ぜんぶで　１０しゅるい　いじょう　あるんだぜ
structure.en: there are more than ten kinds in all, you know

structure.jp: どこにいく　ふねかは
structure.en: as for where the ships go

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and gives an explaining tone; ぜ is a rough, manly 'you know'. あるんだぜ = 'there are, you know'.

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.span: どこにいく　ふねかは
patterns.explanation: か after a question word phrase turns it into a question inside a bigger sentence. どこにいく　ふねかは　しらん = 'I don't know where the ships go'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん on the end of a verb is a rough, shortened ない, meaning 'not'. しらん = 'I don't know'.
